title: Stored-row refusals in order: the body, an unknown load, an unknown record, a record of another load, nothing left to try; nothing dispatched

body.code:
import time
from hie import DataError


def transform(record, context):
    pass
    value = str(record["value"])
    try:
        number = float(value)
    except ValueError:
        raise DataError(f"value {value!r} is not a number")
    return {
        "resourceType": "Observation",
        "id": f"obs-{record['id']}",
        "status": record.get("status") or "final",
        "code": {"text": "glucose"},
        "valueQuantity": {"value": number},
        "note": [{"text": "v1"}],
    }
